notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1934 build, the 1962 destruction and the 75-foot L-6 design; the Forest Service list (2016, compiled by Margaret Sand, Walde Lookout and Cindy Schacher) also gives 6876 ft and 9 miles SSE of Kelly Creek RS. Staffing rests on one name with no date. No source describes the site today, and the brief's access 'unknown' is kept, not set. Photo: the Forest Service list shows none. Also note the Idaho page's Armstrong Peak entry (1934, 60-ft L-6, destroyed 1962) is a different lookout and was not used.
